description: Core events, the pane commands, the folder picker the target chooser needs, the two window writes that restore a saved size/position on launch, and the drag the overlay title bar needs to move the window. The `evaluator` label is WP-15's second window: capabilities are scoped by label, so a window missing from this list gets no `invoke` and no `listen` at all — it would render a terminal that can never spawn or receive a byte, with no error to say why.
